basic_details.job_title: Mormugao Port Authority Technical Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online

age_limit.details: Age of the candidate should not exceed 32 years as on 01.10.2026.

salary_details.details: Selected candidates are entitled to free medical treatment in MPA hospital for self only to the extent of available facilities. Port accommodation may be provided subject to availability at prevailing rent and other charges, along with water and electricity charges at actuals.

selection_process: SECTION – I Question on Civil Engineering 60 questions of 1 mark each 60 1 ½ hours
SECTION -II Logical reasoning 15 questions of 1 mark each 15 1 ½ hours
SECTION – III Basic English 10 questions of 1 mark each 10 1 ½ hours
The selection process consists of application scrutiny
and an oral interview carrying 15% marks.

There shall be -0.25 negative marks for each wrong answer. Candidates must score a minimum of 50% marks in Section I (Civil Engineering) with 50% in aggregate put together to qualify for shortlisting to the oral interview.

Qualifying marks in the oral interview shall be 50% of the total marks assigned in the interview. Final selection is based on total qualifying marks scored in the written exam and oral interview taken together.
how_to_apply: Download the official notification PDF and review the prescribed proforma format for application under Annexure-I.
Fill out the application format and place your resume directly in the body of the email.
Affix a self-attested recent passport-size photo and sign across it on the application proforma.
Prepare self-certified and scanned copies of all supporting documents towards age, educational qualification, and experience, merging them into a single PDF file.
Send the email with the resume in the body and the single PDF attachment exclusively to [email protected] on or before 19.10.2026 by 14.00 hrs.
Keep the return acknowledgement email containing your assigned Roll Number for future communication and correspondence.
important_instructions: Applications must be emailed only to [email protected]; resumes/applications sent merely as attachments without the resume in the email body will not be accepted. Soft copies received after the scheduled date and time, incomplete applications, or those submitted without compliance instructions shall not be considered under any circumstances. Candidates provisionally found eligible must report to the HRD Training Centre, MPA, Headland Sada on 28.10.2026 at 9.30 am with original documents. No candidates shall be allowed to enter the exam centre after 9:45 am on 28.10.2026. The contract engagement is for a period of two years and will automatically terminate upon expiry. The contract engagement does not confer any right to claim permanent absorption in Port service. Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidate.

Keep the return acknowledgement email containing your assigned Roll Number for future communication and correspondence.
